note.question: What determines the multiple-time-period, short-term production scheduling problem for a network of multiple open-pit mines and ports?
note.overview: The model considers the multiple-time-period, short-term production scheduling problem for a network of multiple open-pit mines and ports. Ore produced at each mine, in each period, is transported by rail to a set of ports and blended into products for shipping. Each port forms these blends to a specification, as stipulated in contracts with downstream customers.
